title: TitanMC
description: Classic Prison, No crazy enchantments, No visual overstimulation, Just Prison.
body:
**Classic Prison, No crazy enchantments, No visual overstimulation, Just Prison.**

## Some Features Include

Commissary - Have a lot of items to sell? The server will give you a boosted shop with prices better then market!

Quests - What is a prison without quests? Make use of our many quests to rise to the top

Auction house - Players who didn't pay their rent have their items auctioned off, be quick and purchase these!

Prestiging rewards - We have 100 Prestiges, all with individual rewards! Reach Prestige 1 for un-evictable private cells, and a private mine!

In-game store - We understand how frustrating P2W is, you can purchase anything from the store in-game

Custom Tools - 5 custom tools, all with special effects to make mining more enjoyable

Black Market - Sell or buy anything you want in the black market

Cells - Sell your items on the black market and store valuables. Don't forget to pay your rent!

Crates - We have many crates, The Vote Crate can be used any time you vote, be online for events and receive an Event key (the best in the server!)

## Ward Progression

E-Ward: This is the default ward, get started and make your name known in the prison.

D-Ward: Congratulations, you have reached D-ward, here you get an upgraded mine, new quests, bigger cells and better item sell prices. Watch out for the PvP zones, guards do not watch these areas..

C-Ward: You are now reaching the rich, enjoy a upgraded mine with bigger cells and quests that pay out more.

B-Ward: You are one rank away from the highest!

A-Ward: Enjoy the biggest ward cells available, including the best paying quests, mine and the best sell prices (apart from The Commissary!).

We are constantly updating the server, main changes occur during resets (where we release a new season). These seasons (usually) come with a minecraft version update, allowing us more freedom to add new features. Check our discord for the most up-to-date changes and view sneak peaks by boosting!

We hope to see you, inmates.
